product.title: 3 Hour Back-Road Safari to Grand Canyon with Entrance Gate By-Pass at 9:30 am

description.text: Morning safari vehicle pickup in Tusayan uses back roads to enter the South Rim without waiting at the main gate. Three hours of guided stops include Yavapai Point, views above Bright Angel Trail, and time near Hopi House in Grand Canyon Village.

highlights: Morning 9:30 AM back-road safari from Tusayan
Entrance gate bypass saves time entering the park
Stops at Yavapai Point and Bright Angel Trail overlook
Visit Hopi House in Grand Canyon Village

start.description: 9:30 AM pickup from Tusayan hotels and the National Geographic Visitor Center.

end.description: Return to your Tusayan pickup point after the village and rim loop.

product.itinerarySummary: Morning safari vehicle pickup in Tusayan uses back roads to enter the South Rim without waiting at the main gate.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon South Rim
itineraryItems.description: Enter via back roads and begin the three-hour rim and village loop.

itineraryItems.title: Yavapai Point
itineraryItems.description: Stop at Yavapai Point for panoramic views of the inner canyon.

itineraryItems.title: Bright Angel Trail
itineraryItems.description: Viewpoint above Bright Angel Trailhead to watch hikers on the upper switchbacks.

itineraryItems.title: Hopi House
itineraryItems.description: Stop at Mary Colter's Hopi House for architecture and artisan crafts in the village.
